[[Gorobei]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] who trades [[armor]] pieces for [[trophy|trophies]]. 

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Haiju Lagoon}}

==Dialogue==
:''"In my youth, my family lived in a small village on the northeastern coast of Shing Jea Island. That is, until the [[Naga]] burned down my village and slaughtered my loved ones. At first I constantly questioned the [[Gods of Tyria|gods]] why I was left behind, but then it came to me: I was left here to revenge my family's death. It is my duty, given me by the gods, to destroy the Naga and everything they hold dear. If you kill any of these abhorrent beasts, bring me their pelts as proof. For 3 [[Naga Pelt]]s, I will give you this in return:"''
{{Collector no armor trade dialogue|Naga Pelts}}
